notes: The article before θεόν is unrepresented because the ASV supplies no determiner of any kind — neither the, nor a, nor a demonstrative — so rules 19, 51 and 60 are all out and rule 23 decides it.
Anarthrous substantival οὗτος → the same takes the supplied determiner as a rule 7 helper and heads on the demonstrative word, not on the (rule 17).
